findings.current: On some midsummer days, hail poured down in place of the monsoon rains.
findings.defect: Changes a single midsummer day into multiple days.
findings.rationale: 어느 날 refers to one day.
findings.replacement: One midsummer day, hail poured down in place of the monsoon rains.
findings.source: 한여름의 어느 날에는 장맛비 대신 우박이 쏟아지기도 했고

findings.current: by the time a sack of it had passed through a few hands, it had dwindled to a single handful.
findings.defect: Renders the measured quantity 한 홉 as a handful.
findings.rationale: A hop is a volume measure of roughly 180 milliliters, not a handful.
findings.replacement: by the time a sack of it had passed through a few hands, it had dwindled to a single cup.
findings.source: 한 가마니의 쌀은 몇 사람의 손을 거쳐 한 홉으로 줄어들었다.

findings.defect: Turns each doomed bandit’s question about their own fate into a general question about events.
findings.rationale: 자신이 makes the question personal to the person facing death.
findings.replacement: *How had I ended up like this?*
findings.source: 자신이 어째서 이렇게 된 걸까, 하는 의문을.

findings.current: His counterpart, however, could learn everything happening within a hundred-odd yards by his own power alone.
findings.defect: Treats a jang as a yard, shrinking the radius of Mae Jonghak’s perception by roughly a factor of three.
findings.rationale: 백여 장 is over one hundred jang; one jang is roughly 3.3 meters.
findings.replacement: His counterpart, however, could sense everything happening within a radius of more than three hundred yards by his own power alone.
findings.source: 상대는 혼자만의 힘으로 반경 백여 장 안에 벌어지는 모든 일을 파악할 수 있으니.

findings.current: The man continued to speak down to the old man without hesitation.
findings.defect: Implies condescension where the source describes Mae Jonghak’s natural use of familiar speech.
findings.rationale: 하대 marks speech hierarchy here; the following sentence establishes his standing to use it, not contempt for Song Ho.
findings.replacement: The man continued to address the old man with the easy familiarity of a senior.

findings.current: Shanxi Province had a considerable number of elite government troops.
findings.defect: Adds a claim about how many elite troops Shanxi had.
findings.rationale: 상당한 정예 describes the troops’ caliber, not the number of elite troops.
findings.replacement: The government troops stationed in Shanxi Province were highly capable.

findings.current: “You were so busy taking in the whole forest that you failed to see the small Go within it.”
findings.defect: Replaces a small branch in the forest metaphor with the unrelated game Go.
findings.rationale: 나뭇가지 is a tree branch; Mae Jonghak’s metaphor leads directly into Song Ho’s later reference to that branch.
findings.replacement: “You were so busy looking at the whole forest that you failed to see the small branch within it.”
findings.source: 숲 전체를 살피기에 바빠, 그 안의 작은 나뭇가지를 보지 못했다는 것.

findings.current: With a motion of Mae Jonghak’s hand, a surge of energy reached out and pushed open the firmly shut door.
findings.defect: Uses generic energy for Murim 기운 and weakens 열어젖힌, which indicates the door was flung open.
findings.rationale: The source identifies Murim energy and describes a forceful opening.
findings.replacement: With a motion of Mae Jonghak’s hand, a surge of qi reached out and flung open the firmly shut door.
findings.source: 매종학의 손짓과 함께 뻗어 나온 기운이 굳게 닫혀 있던 문을 열어젖힌 것도.

findings.current: “I understand now. I know the name of the Go I failed to see.”
findings.defect: Repeats the mistaken Go rendering and breaks Song Ho’s reference back to Mae Jonghak’s branch metaphor.
findings.rationale: 그 가지 refers to the small branch Mae Jonghak just described.
findings.replacement: “I understand now. I know the name of the branch I failed to see.”
findings.source: 제가 미처 보지 못한 그 가지의 이름을.

summary: Several localized errors change quantities, characterization, and a recurring metaphor.
